idea-plugin.name: Services View
idea-plugin.description:
Provides the Services tool window. The tool window shows the services of the project in one tree. It includes the run and debug configurations, the remote server connections, and the deployments.
Start, debug, or stop a service from the tree, then follow its status and its console output. Group the tree by type, by status, or by folder, and filter it to the services that you need. Open a service in a new tab, or move it to a separate tool window.
Other plugins add their own services to the same tree such as Database, Docker, MCP Server and Kubernetes.
